description: Create a new NAS volume instance. Use dryRun=true to preview.

cifsUserName.description: CIFS user name (required when protocol is CIFS)

cifsUserPassword.description: CIFS user password (required when protocol is CIFS)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating

serverInstanceNoList.description: List of server instance numbers for access control

volumeAllotmentProtocolTypeCode.description: Volume protocol type code (NFS or CIFS)

volumeSize.description: Volume size in GB (500~10000, in 100GB increments)

vpcNo.description: VPC number where the NAS volume will be created

name: ncloud_create_nas_volume
